description: **`warscape/trailer.py` follow-ups of W36**: (a) add `--no-advice`, `--no-lazy-fetch` and `--attr-source` (both forms) to the option sets; (b) add `timeout`, `nice`, `time -p` and `env -i` to `GIT`'s wrappers, and let `WORD` take a nested `$(...)`; (c) name wrappers as unseen in `commit_lacks_trailer`'s docstring; (d) ignore an alias that shadows a builtin (`git -c alias.status=commit status` is no commit); (e) follow a line continuation (`git \<newline> commit`) Why: each fails open except (d), and none reaches napoleon, which passes a canonical string, but a hook passing the command as typed would miss these commits Raised: W36 review, round 1, 2026-11-05
title: `warscape/trailer.py` follow-ups of W36
